comment: Machine-readable index of PRINCIPLES.md. One entry per invariant. status: 'enforced' (test passes; regression fails CI), 'violated' (known broken; its tests are xfail(strict=True) so the fix forces flipping this to 'enforced'), 'untested' (test documents the intent but needs wiring it cannot reach yet; skipped). The meta-tests in test_meta.py keep this file, PRINCIPLES.md, and the test files in sync.

invariants.summary: no public job constructor accepts name=
equal jobs with different destinations coexist without conflict
changing only a published path causes zero rebuilds and a working link
entry content layout derives from output names, never publish paths
user-facing job references show published paths and/or definition site

principles.title: The only conflict is a contested destination

invariants.summary: two different jobs on one destination: error naming both call sites
identical jobs, different destinations: built once, linked twice
no 'duplicate job id' error class exists; identical redefinition merges

principles.title: One truth; everything else is a pointer or a cache

invariants.summary: zero writable stores fails at run start, once, as a config error
deleting every cache-class file costs zero rebuilds
deleting the project dir (keeping the store) costs zero rebuilds
generation pointer state has one authoritative form; disagreement is detected
invariants.note: ppg3.verify_generation(project_dir) cross-checks record vs tree both ways

principles.title: A declared input is a readable input

invariants.summary: File inputs are byte-identical readable inside the job
parent-job inputs expose the parent's bytes
subset refs key on exactly the named output (per-output early cutoff)
Params are readable via io.params, value-identical

principles.title: Same key, same bytes; everything that runs is an input

invariants.summary: different bytes under an existing input key is a hard failure
the violation report names both entries on disk and the next command
a tool hash change is a key change (rebuild)
declared env keys the job; undeclared env is invisible

principles.title: The sandbox is a feature you can hold

invariants.summary: ppg3.new(sandbox=...) exists and reaches executor selection
sandbox='require' without enforcement fails at run start
invariants.note: asserted on hosts without enforcement; skips where bwrap+nix exist (require then succeeds)

invariants.summary: undeclared input is ENOENT inside the job
invariants.note: wiring landed (sandbox=auto/require selects BwrapExecutor); flip to enforced after the first green run on a bwrap+nix host (nix CI)

invariants.summary: manifests record the enforcement that actually applied
unenforced runs warn exactly once per run

principles.title: A fetch pin is an identity, not a comment

invariants.summary: the declared hash participates in the input key
removing the pin (interactive) refetches and re-pins, never hits silently
changing the URL refetches even when matching content exists
verification failure reports url, both hashes, and the rejected bytes' path
after a failed run, succeeded jobs rerun as pure hits
a failed run leaves an inspectable, marked partial generation
current never points at a partial snapshot
job-failure blocks include the definition site
failure blocks include a log path; single failures inline the log tail
violation/mismatch reports include on-disk paths of every artifact mentioned
no bare hash appears without an accompanying path or name
job constructors take outputs=; view= does not exist
a job without published outputs is legal (internal job)
